passport.intro: Your skills as Kafa'a derives them from recorded evidence: qualification records, courses, assessments, JPMs, validated ratings and credentials. Every level shows how it was evidenced.
passport.yearsNote: from hire date; role history is not mirrored
passport.statExpiringSub: qualifications within 90 days and ageing skills
passport.noPersonBody: This person is not in your scope, or has no Kafa'a profile.

radar.title: Skills radar
radar.figTitle: Skills radar: my level against the requirements of {role}
radar.tooFew: Not enough axes for a radar: see the table below.
radar.securityTarget: Security roles show the career path only: no readiness is computed.

strengths.title: Strengths for my next move
strengths.none: No transferable strength found for the roles you can reach.
strengths.noRole: No current role is recorded, so next moves cannot be computed.

expiring.title: Expiring and decaying
expiring.intro: Qualifications with a 90, 60 or 30-day notice, and skills whose evidence is ageing (older than 36 months counts one level lower).
expiring.qualsEyebrow: Mirror of the training records system
expiring.noQuals: Nothing expires in the next 90 days.

state.ageing: Evidence from {date}: counted one level lower

list.title: Skills
list.intro: Each skill shows its level, how it was evidenced and the confidence. Select a basis chip to see the records behind it.

evidence.intro: Strongest evidence first. Kafa'a reads these records from the systems that hold them; it does not create them.
evidence.mirrorNote: Qualification and licence entries mirror the licensee's systems. Kafa'a is not an authority.

claims.title: My claims
claims.intro: Self-rated skills stay "claimed" until a manager or peer validates them.
claims.noneBody: Add a claim for a skill you use that no record shows yet.
claims.awaiting: Awaiting validation by a manager or peer.

claim.title: Add a skill claim
claim.intro: Rate a skill you use. The claim shows on your passport as "claimed" and counts less than recorded evidence until it is validated.
claim.securityNote: Security competencies cannot be self-claimed: they show as qualified or not qualified only.
claim.noteHint: A short note, 3 to 500 characters. Do not include personal or security details.
claim.urlHint: An http(s) link, for example to a published report.
claim.urlBad: Use an http or https address of up to 300 characters.
claim.done: Claim added: it stays "claimed" until validated

notAuthority.title: Kafa'a is not an authority
notAuthority.body: Qualification and licence lines mirror the licensee's systems. Skill levels are inferred from recorded evidence to support development conversations; they are not a FANR certification or a qualification decision.

team.intro: A read-only view of the skills passport of a person in your scope.
team.readOnlyBody: Only the holder can add claims or issue badges. Use it to prepare a development conversation.

print.intro: A one-page passport in the language you are reading. It carries no email, no photo and no task detail.
print.title: Kafa'a Skills Passport
print.subtitle: Skills derived from recorded evidence · demo tenant (synthetic data)
print.more: More skills are listed in the online passport.
print.footer: Kafa'a is not an authority. Qualification and licence entries mirror the licensee's systems; skill levels are inferred from recorded evidence and are not a FANR certification or licence. Concept demo with synthetic data.

wallet.intro: Wrap your Kafa'a course certificates and completions in signed, shareable badges (Open Badges 3.0 format).
wallet.notice: Internal Kafa'a credential; not a FANR certificate or licence. Licences and qualification records are never issued as badges.
wallet.noneBody: Issue a badge from one of your certificates or course completions below.
wallet.noSources: No Kafa'a certificate or course completion is recorded for you yet.
wallet.issueConsequence: Kafa'a signs an Open Badges 3.0 credential with its issuer key and records the action in the audit log and the NEXUS evidence ledger. Anyone with the share link sees your initials, the course and the skills it evidences.
wallet.neverMirrors: FANR licences and qualification mirrors are never issued as badges. Security-related training shows as qualified or not qualified only.
wallet.how1: Each badge is an Open Badges 3.0-shaped credential: the course, its criteria, the Kafa'a skills it aligns to and the evidence.
wallet.how2: It is signed with an Ed25519 key. Changing any field of the downloaded file makes the signature invalid.
wallet.how3: The share link shows your initials only. A badge expires with its certificate and can be withdrawn at any time.

badge.withdrawConsequence: The verify page will show the badge as revoked from now on, and the skill evidence it added is removed from your passport. The action is audited.

sig.validOffline: Signed with the offline demo key

verify.intro: Check a Kafa'a badge: its signature, its current status and what it certifies. Only the holder's initials are shown.
verify.bannerTitle: Not a FANR certificate or licence
verify.notFoundBody: No Kafa'a badge has this link. Check the address with the holder.
verify.invalidBody: This file was changed after it was issued, or it was not issued by Kafa'a. Do not rely on it.

statusBody.expired: The signature is genuine, but the badge or its certificate is past its validity date.
statusBody.revoked: The signature is genuine, but the badge or its certificate has been revoked.

verify.pasteHint: The file the holder downloaded from their Kafa'a wallet.
verify.unknownBody: The signature checks out, but this badge is not in the registry of this Kafa'a tenant.
verify.privacy: The file is checked in your browser and is not uploaded. To check a certificate number instead:
verify.keysNote: Signatures are checked against the issuer keys Kafa'a publishes.
